_meta.description: Dated part-of placements (design §6.4, H16) found in the research, between bodies kept in phase 1. A placement never changes identity. Placements involving an excluded or held-out body are omitted (listed in .superpowers/sdd/2026-10-25-crcdr-phase1/task-5-report.md).
_meta.dates: 'from' inclusive, 'to' exclusive, null = still open. Where an end is not stated by an act, 'to' is the date the body's status changed in the research (noted per entry).

entries.source: Pius X, ap. const. Sapienti consilio, 6° n.6, AAS 1 (1909): 'Unitam habet Congregationem pro Negotiis rituum orientalium'; name 'S. Congregatio de Propaganda Fide pro negotiis ritus orientalis' per Benedict XV, m.p. Dei providentis, AAS 9-I (1917) 529-531
entries.note: The union with Propaganda is verified in Sapienti consilio (primary) for 1908; that it held from the founding date (1862-01-06, itself secondary) is the research's 'attached section' reading. Ends with the body (30 Nov 1917, Dei providentis).

entries.source: Paul VI, m.p. Apostolicae caritatis, 19 Mar 1970, AAS 62 (1970) 193ff: 'Sacrae Congregationi pro Episcopis obnoxiam'
entries.note: Its president is the Prefect of Bishops. End = PB's entry into force, when it became a Pontifical Council (research curia_status '1970-1988'); no act read states the end of the subjection.

entries.source: John Paul II, m.p. Dolentium hominum, 11 Feb 1985, AAS 77 (1985) 457ff: 'Consociari hanc Commissionem ... cum Pontificio Consilio pro Laicis, cuius complens sit ipsa pars'
entries.note: End = PB's entry into force, when it became a Pontifical Council (research curia_status '1985-1988'); no act read states the end.

entries.source: John Paul II, ap. const. Pastor bonus, Arts. 99-104 (placement); John Paul II, m.p. Inde a Pontificatus, 25 Mar 1993 (detached, made autonomous, renamed)
entries.note: H16: placed inside the Congregation for the Clergy by PB.

entries.source: Research curia_status: 'Committee/Council for the Family within the Laity council (1973); not a separate dicastery' (founding act not read; secondary); end per John Paul II, m.p. Familia a Deo instituta, 9 May 1981, AAS 73 (1981) 441-445
entries.note: Not in the H16 list, but stated by the research. Ends with the body (1981).

entries.source: John Paul II, ap. const. Pastor bonus, Arts. 83-84 (research curia_status: 'attached to the Congregation/Dicastery for Bishops')
entries.note: The research says 'attached'; 'within' is chosen editorially because PB treats the Commission inside the Congregation's own articles, as it does Cultural Heritage inside Clergy. Placement before PB (1958-1989) not traced, so 'from' is PB's entry into force; continues under PE (research: 'Congregation/Dicastery').

entries.source: Francis, ap. const. Praedicate Evangelium, Art. 78 §1, in force 5 Jun 2022
entries.note: H16: 'established within' the DDF. Research event ev102 types this as an attachment.
